therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: prevention of radiation-induced bone loss and cortical thinning
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with peripheral lung tumors treated with SBRT
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: changes in mean cortical thickness at 3 months post radiation

results.effect_size: 4.24% vs 7.14% cortical thickness change (risedronate vs placebo)
results.target_engagement_evidence: urinary N-telopeptide levels measured as osteoclast activity biomarker
biomarker_changes: urinary N-telopeptide levels varied over time with different patterns between groups
subgroup_findings: greater protective effect in higher radiation dose regions (>40 Gy): -1.44% vs 17.17% at 12 months
dose-dependent radiation effect on cortical thickness changes
results.dose_information: risedronate 150 mg oral, given once 7-21 days prior to SBRT initiation
